title: Air Fish
description: A plugin that lets fish and aquatic mobs survive out of water when given Water Breathing.
body:
## Ever wanted to allow our fishy friends to breathe air? Look no further!

With AirFish, you can simply throw a water breathing potion on any water mob or feed it to them directly for infinite breathing! Are they becoming too conscious and starting to question reality? Interact with them while holding a milk bucket to revert the effects!

Show your fishy friends around while they're able to breathe with the new ability to use leashes on fish! Or imprison them in your own personal fish tank.

Oh and let's not forget the radioactive effects of allowing fish to breathe air, so now you can easily see your capable fishy friends by their glowing outline!

## DEFAULT CONFIGURATION
## 

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


```yaml
Settings:
  # If enabled, players can interact with a fish or squid while holding
  # a potion of water breathing and allow it to breathe air infinitely!
  #
  # Can be removed by interacting with a milk bucket!
  Edible-Infinite-Breathing: true
  # If enabled, players can interact with any fish while holding a lead
  # and walk them around like any other entity.
  Fish-Walking: true
  # If enabled, fish and squids with water breathing will glow
  # to signify their superiority to fish who cannot breathe air.
  Fish-Glow: true
```


</details>
